title: Strictness of the transformed circuit
statement: Let $n>0$, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input vertices in which every gate reads at most two vertices and the gate arguments are distinct, with every NOT gate reading exactly one vertex. Then every gate in the circuit obtained by adjoining the three-gate constant prefix and transforming the gates has distinct arguments and has exactly one argument if it is a NOT gate and exactly two arguments otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Circuit has well-formed gates with distinct arguments
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
